source: Tables I-V of the ICDM 2026 submission (paper/paper_tex/main.tex); quoted rows carry their citation.

locbench_small.title: LocBench, small-model lane
locbench_small.caption: 560 issues, 165 repos; no component larger than 9B anywhere in the pipeline. Strict file-level accuracy (all gold files in top-k) under the benchmark's official edit_functions ground truth. Our runs cover 559/560 instances.

locbench_heavy.title: LocBench, heavyweight lane
locbench_heavy.caption: Frontier-model agents and a trained 32B reranker against one call to an open-weights mixture of experts over our unchanged candidate baskets.

swebench.title: Issue → files on SWE-bench
swebench.caption: Strict file-level Acc@5 (all gold files in the top 5), leakage-free protocol: every signal is computed from the repository state strictly before the fix.

ablation.title: Ablation on LocBench
ablation.caption: n=559, strict Acc@5; full method 67.4 (candidates only, no LLM). One component removed at a time; p from exact McNemar. Every hyper-parameter is inert: layer mix α, decay λ, iterations, restart and RRF k all give |Δ| ≤ 0.7, p > 0.18.

rows.name: Rank fusion replaced by fixed-cap union
without paths quoted in the issue

impact.title: Impact set: given one changed file, predict the rest
impact.caption: 2,309 recent multi-file commits from 12 projects, each held out from its own graph. History dominates structure here — and the twenty-year-old ROSE co-change counter still beats our propagation variants on 7 of 12 projects. We report this negative result prominently; it is exactly the evidence the UI surfaces.

pareto.title: Strict Acc@5 versus cost per issue on LocBench
pareto.caption: Only systems with a published dollar figure are plotted; fine-tuned systems (LocAgent-7B, SweRank) additionally require standing GPU serving, which the dollar axis does not capture. Training-free points at ~$0 sit on the left edge.
